title: Custom Hooks Patterns
description: Master custom hooks for reusable logic, data fetching, form handling, and common UI patterns.

data.text: Custom hooks extract reusable logic from components. They start with 'use' and can call other hooks. This enables composition and code reuse.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Custom hooks extract and reuse stateful logic
Common patterns: useFetch, useForm, useDebounce, useLocalStorage
data.takeaway: Custom hooks are the primary way to reuse stateful logic in React. Build a library of well-tested hooks for common patterns in your application.
